_comment: Pilot config for staging.getzemam.com. Arabic RTL ERP — see notes at the bottom of this file before widening scope.
_notes: settleMs is 2000 rather than the 700 default: ERP grids and dashboards typically render behind a loading state, and snapshotting a skeleton yields near-zero control counts.
maxRoutes is 8 for the pilot. Confirm control counts look sane, then widen.
The Arabic patterns matter more than the English ones here. In an accounting context ترحيل (post) and إقفال (period close) are the genuinely dangerous labels, not حذف.
readOnly must stay true on any ERP. Posted ledger entries are typically not deletable, only reversible, so a stray write leaves permanent artifacts in the seed data.
Verify before running whether staging's e-invoicing integration points at a real ETA sandbox. If it does, treat every send/issue control as out of scope regardless of readOnly.
interactionDepth 2 explores one level inside modals and tab panels. Each level multiplies runtime by roughly the average interior control count, so keep maxRoutes low while piloting.
